Statement: Parent counts are sensitivity cases only. Phase 3B does not map deterministic Pathways edges directly into Bayesian dependencies.
Parent state cases use measured median and p90 authored answer cardinality, applied homogeneously to isolate CPT growth.
Storage figures count probability arrays only. They exclude node objects, factor metadata, indexes, evidence caches and interpreter overhead.
Runtime memory and serialised artefact size will be measured in Phase 3C against a concrete BN implementation rather than estimated from an arbitrary multiplier.
